evidence: feed-service.lisp:166-171: (fd (fnn-open path (logior sb-posix:o-rdonly +fnn-o-nofollow+))) ... (let ((info (fnn-fstat fd))) (unless (and (fnn-regular-p info) ...) (error 'fnn-feed-auth-error)). io.lisp:454-455: fnn-open is a plain sb-posix:open.
failure-message: credential FIFO must refuse without blocking
fix: Open with O_NONBLOCK (or lstat first and refuse a non-regular file before open), then clear O_NONBLOCK or read through the bounded reader. Keep the fstat check as the authority.
reviewer: feed-service.lisp:166 opens with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW and no O_NONBLOCK. fnn-open (io.lisp:454-455) is a plain sb-posix:open, so a FIFO blocks there before fnn-regular-p (169). In fnn-feed-dial the socket is connected (418) but not yet published, so fnn-feed-service-wake (600-613) cannot shut it down, and fnn-feed-service-close's join-thread (621) waits forever. pull-service.lisp:311 reuses the same function. It is only reachable when the operator-configured private profile path is a FIFO, which needs the operator or someone with write access to that directory, so the severity is low.
scenario: The configured authinfo profile path is (or is replaced by) a FIFO. O_NOFOLLOW does not reject FIFOs, so open(O_RDONLY) blocks until a writer appears, before fnn-regular-p is ever checked. The feed worker blocks inside fnn-feed-dial with a TCP connection already open to the peer (line 418). fnn-feed-service-wake can only shut down sockets published in the link table, and this one is not yet published, so fnn-feed-service-close's join-thread waits forever and owner shutdown hangs. fnn-pull-profile (pull-service.lisp:309) reuses this function, so the pull worker hangs the same way.
title: Credential profile opened without O_NONBLOCK before the regular-file check: a FIFO hangs the feed worker and the owner close join
